newsitem.title: turkmenistan: Turkish firm to build paper maker in Turkmenistan.
newsitem.headline: Turkish firm to build paper maker in Turkmenistan.

text.p: Turkey's ART Kagit Sanai Tidjaret will build a $183 million cellulose and paper factory to begin operating in Turkmenistan by 1998, an Energy and Industry Ministry official told Reuters on Monday.
The annual capacity of the factory will be 40,000 tonnes of cellulose and 40,000 tonnes of paper, the official said.

"The work of the factory will largely satisfy internal demand for paper and thus essentially cut down the expenditure of state hard-currency reserves on imports of this kind of output," the official said.
ART Kagit Sanai Tidjaret will finance the entire $183 million project cost with guarantees from Turkey's Eximbank.
The official did not name sources from which the desert country, which has already cut much of its forest, would obtain raw materials necessary to produce cellulose and paper.
Under the contract with the Turkmen government, the factory is to start working in 1998.
